summary: Professional with extensive experience in Human Resources within the Oil & Gas industry, seeking to leverage strong organizational, administrative, and communication skills to support organizational and personal goals.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Mobilized high‑volume employees overseas for short/long‑term assignments.
Served as point of contact from assignment initiation to completion.
Implemented HR policies, procedures, and guidance for field managers.
Created compensation packages including uplifts, per diem, and benefits.
Managed employee relations, policy development, training, recruitment, payroll, and benefits.
Assisted in rewriting international assignment policies.
Conducted interviews and trained new hires.
Administered the Goods and Services review program biannually.
Evaluated new hire documents and provided staff training.
Prepared and presented training seminars to HR professionals.
Resolved employee issues related to benefits, payroll, HR systems, and administration.
Managed assignments across Germany, Kuwait, Brazil, Australia, Italy, Mexico, China, Zambia, and Angola.

experience.title: HR Associate Mobilization Coordinator
responsibilities: Handled unemployment and workers' compensation claims and maintained personnel files.
Responded sensitively to employee concerns.
Presented company policies, procedures, and benefits to new hires.
Assisted in writing policies and procedures.
Arranged medical appointments, travel, housing, and tax briefings for assignments.
Prepared personnel transfer paperwork and correspondence.
Applied for entry and work visas.
Managed assignments in Nigeria, Chad, Indonesia, Algeria, Canada, and Qatar.

experience.title: Administrative Specialist / Tax Assistant
responsibilities: Managed the Tax Equalization Program for expats and inpats.
Collected and verified check payments for payroll endorsement.
Assisted expats with tax forms and inquiries.
Processed reimbursement requests for P&I and IRS notices.
Initiated move notices and administered Certificate of Coverage program.
Ordered office supplies from vendors.
Composed correspondence via email or certified mail.
Backed up timesheet keeper and web panel initiator.
Processed invoices and overhead financial numbers.

experience.title: Administrative Associate
responsibilities: Provided administrative support to a department.
Completed tasks per standard procedures.
Supported general business operations with administrative activities.
Compiled, copied, sorted, and filed office records.
Distributed departmental and employee mail.
Set up pouch mail for new projects.
Took passport and visa pictures.
Notified payroll, HR, and A&F of employee assignments.
Maintained a clean and organized office area.
